newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks tumble, few resist downward trend.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks tumble, few resist downward trend.

text.p: Almost all Croatian stocks tumbled due to scarce buying on Wednesday and few selected issues resisted what appeared to be a general slide.
* Eight of 11 active stocks fell and three were flat.
* Volume shrank to 7,875 and turnover to 3.9 million kuna.
* Most actively traded issue was food concern Podravka, closing five kuna lower at 330 on volume of 3,376 units.
* Hotelier Istraturist led decliners, falling 30 kuna or 12.2 percent to 215 kuna with 199 shares sold.
* Blue chip Zagrebacka Banka ordinaries lost 2.12 percent to 1,850 kuna on volume of 61.
* Another fully-listed issue, drugs firm Pliva, ended unchanged at 470 kuna with 556 shares sold.
